role: typed chain monitor decision core (ports lib/agent-functions.sh monitor-chain-agent): watch the agent, latch completion, classify stale/dead, and gate the completion handoff on a genuine done signal. Design rationale + migration plan live in monitor-v2-contract.json; this file is the enforceable owns/invariants bound by the switch-readiness gate.
owns: the typed chain monitor poll-loop decision (classifyMonitorTick) and its action set
the completion latch decision (sticky AGENT_COMPLETE marker OR emitted event)
stale/nudge classification with a durable, restart-surviving nudge budget
event-first death classification and BLOCKED stall surfacing
invariants: dead without a declared event is not success (event-first death)
the completion latch wins over process death
liveness wins: an alive, producing agent with no event is never failed
the durable nudge budget survives screen-echo resets (echo grace)
diagnostic events use source monitor, never the agent id, so they cannot satisfy the completion matcher
completion is invoked only on a genuine latch, never while alive and eventless
remote (ssh/docker) workspaces skip the local process-death check
the completion handoff wiring (gate/feed liveness, connect late-event recovery) is connected before readiness
